WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) as rental_total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
avg_rental AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) as avg_total
  FROM (
    SELECT r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) as rental_total
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.rental_id
  ) sub
)
SELECT 
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.rental_total) as combined_payment_total,
  AVG(rt.rental_total - ar.avg_total) as avg_beat
FROM rental_totals rt, avg_rental ar
WHERE rt.rental_total > ar.avg_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id
